data: At approximately what standard deviation does the blue line reach a peak?

The blue line represents the density of the scaled standard deviations before 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch. The black line represents the same after 100 iterations. The blue line reaches its peak at approximately 1.0 on the x-axis, which corresponds to the standard deviation. Therefore, the blue line reaches a peak at approximately 1.0 standard deviation.
